company.shortDescription: Skrooge.ai offers AI-driven accounting and tax tools that automate bookkeeping, compliance, and financial reporting.
company.description: Skrooge.ai provides full-stack finance operations for SMEs in the UAE. Our human-plus-AI model automates data capture, reconciliations, and compliance checks, then adds certified accountant oversight for dual assurance on every document and filing. We manage monthly bookkeeping, VAT and Corporate Tax preparation and submission, invoice workflows, and management reporting. Clients get reliable books, on-time compliance, and CFO-grade insights at a predictable price.
